name: StatusTile
srcDivergence: Deliberate, not stale — preview parameterization. The record's `StatusTile` defaults `status`, so it renders standalone in a preview that mounts records with no props; the file's takes them as required props from its caller. Region-scoped check: the file's `StatusTile` holds 1 substantive line(s) the record lacks — under the 8-line threshold at which parameterization stops being a full explanation, so it is treated as explained. NOT zero, though: if this component ever gained behaviour the record missed, those 1 line(s) are where to look. Refreshing from the file would discard the parameterization.
